Interview Invitation

Dear {{ candidate_name }},

We are pleased to invite you for an interview for the position of {{ job_title }} at {{ company_name }}.

Interview Details:

  • Date: {{ scheduled_date }}
  • Time: {{ scheduled_time }}
  • Mode: {{ interview_mode }}
  • Interviewer: {{ interviewer_name }}
    • {% if interview_link %}
  • Meeting Link: {{ interview_link }}
    • {% endif %}

Please confirm your availability for this scheduled interview.


Best regards,
{{ recruiter_name }}
HR Department, {{ company_name }}
context: candidate_name, job_title, company_name, scheduled_date, scheduled_time, interview_mode, interviewer_name, interview_link, recruiter_name
name: Interview Invitation
subject: Interview Invitation: {{ job_title }} at {{ company_name }}
